text.en:
Project Number (B-224.79), page 464-A, Appendix (A), Title (B) of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred and thirteen is amended to read as follows:
B-224.79 Tiniclan Creek GOB 50.00 To Bridge Minabitasan Road (50.00) To replace temporary Talembong-Na bridge with permanent one (50.00)

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 8, 1961.
